description: Capture a screenshot of the current mobile screen through the active automation driver. Returns the PNG as a viewable image. Optional saveTo also saves a local project-relative PNG without overwriting an existing file.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

saveTo.description: Local-only project-relative PNG destination, e.g. .ceraph/recorded-runs/screenshot.png. Must not already exist.

name: screen_screenshot
